invariants.rationale: Method is expected to return a non-null list of WriteStatus.
Input list of HoodieRecords should not be null, as method operates on its contents.
The instantTime parameter is used as an identifier for the write operation and is expected to be non-null.
Option is used to wrap the BulkInsertPartitioner, which should not be a null reference.
Return value is specified as List<WriteStatus> and should be an instance of List.
